name: Amigurumi Bear
shortDescription: Huggable hand-crocheted teddy bear in soft cotton yarn
description: Meet Bruno - our most beloved amigurumi bear, crafted entirely by hand using 100% premium cotton yarn. Each bear takes over 6 hours to complete and is stuffed with hypoallergenic polyfill. Perfect as a nursery gift, desk companion, or collectible keepsake. Safety eyes, reinforced joints, and lovingly finished with a tiny ribbon bow.
detail_Washable: Hand wash lay flat to dry

name: Cloud Baby Blanket
shortDescription: Ultra-soft stitch-pattern baby blanket in pastel hues
description: Wrap your little one in pure warmth with our Cloud Stitch Baby Blanket. Worked in a luxuriously soft cloud-stitch pattern, this blanket is breathable, stretchy, and gentle on newborn skin. Available in a range of pastel and neutral tones to match any nursery aesthetic. Each blanket is blocked and finished with a neat border.

name: Slouchy Ribbed Beanie
shortDescription: Stretchy ribbed beanie with oversized slouch - one size fits all
description: A wardrobe staple for cooler days. Our Slouchy Ribbed Beanie is worked in a 3x3 rib pattern that gives it the perfect amount of stretch and structure. The generous slouch sits comfortably without being too floppy. Available in over a dozen yarn colours.

name: Sunflower Market Bag
shortDescription: Open-weave cotton tote perfect for the farmers market
description: Stylish and sustainable - our Sunflower Market Bag features a bold open-weave body in natural cotton with a sunflower motif patch crocheted at the base. Strong double handles are reinforced at the join.

name: Boho Coaster Set
shortDescription: Mandala-pattern cotton coasters - set of 4 mixed colours
description: Add a boho touch to your coffee table with our handmade mandala coasters. Each set of four coasters features the same intricate pattern worked in complementary yarn colours. Thick enough to protect surfaces, beautiful enough to be left out as decor.

name: Chunky Infinity Scarf
shortDescription: Cosy oversized loop scarf in chunky arm-weight yarn
description: A quick double-wrap around your neck and you're ready for the cold. Our Chunky Infinity Scarf is worked in a simple but stunning basketweave stitch using super-chunky arm-weight yarn, giving it incredible warmth and texture.

name: Flower Headband
shortDescription: Stretchy ear-warmer headband with a crocheted flower accent
description: Keep your ears toasty without messing up your hair. This stretchy ribbed headband fits comfortably and securely topped with a hand-crocheted flower in a contrasting colour. Great for workouts school runs or just cosy days at home.

name: Baby Booties Pair
shortDescription: Soft-soled crocheted booties for newborns to 6 months
description: Tiny, soft, and utterly adorable - our Baby Booties come in newborn and 0-6 month sizes. Each pair is lovingly crocheted in smooth DK cotton with a non-slip textured sole and a sweet button or bow closure at the ankle.
